figures.finding: A resident pays a flat 10% income tax on his income from all sources (a non-resident on Turkmen-source income), after a monthly deduction of one base amount set by law for computing taxes (more for the disabled and per dependant); the tax period is the tax year.

value.monthlyDeduction: 1 x the base amount (binýatlyk mukdar) set by law

figures.applies: The Unified Law on Taxes as the Tax Administration posts it (text of 5 December 2022); later amendments not checked.

sources.said: Salgyt töleýji tarapyndan alnan şu aşakdaky girdejiler salgyt salynýan binýat diýlip ykrar edilýär: 1) olaryň çeşmelerine bagly bolmazdan – Türkmenistanyň dahyllylary bolup durýan şahsy adamlar üçin; 2) Türkmenistandaky çeşmelerden – Türkmenistanyň dahyllylary bolmadyk şahsy adamlar üçin. … Salgyt döwri diýlip, salgyt ýyly ykrar edilýär. … Şu Bitewi kanunda başgaça bellenilmedik bolsa, salgyt möçberi 10 göterim derejede bellenýär.

salgyt töleýjiniň salgyt döwrüniň her aýynda aşakdaky salgyt aýyrmalaryna hukugy bardyr: a) islendik şahsy tarap - Türkmenistanyň kanunçylygy bilen salgytlary we ýygymlary hasaplamak üçin bellenilen binýatlyk mukdaryň bir essesi möçberinde;

figures.finding: The tax period is the tax year (half-year and year for reporting); a person paid without withholding files by the 25th of the month after the reporting period and pays by the 10th of the second month after it; a foreigner files by 1 April and pays by 15 April of the next year.

value.returnDue: 25th of the month after the reporting period
value.paymentDue: 10th of the second month after the reporting period

figures.applies: The Unified Law on Taxes as the Tax Administration posts it (text of 5 December 2022); later amendments not checked.

Daşary ýurt raýatlary salgyt beýannamasyny geçen salgyt ýylyndan soňky ýylyň aprel aýynyň 1-nden gijä galman berýärler.

figures.finding: A resident legal entity, a non-resident's permanent establishment and a private entrepreneur paying income withhold the 10% from each payment (pay monthly on a cumulative basis) and pay it in when the cash is drawn from the bank; nothing is withheld from payments to private entrepreneurs or under civil-law contracts, whose recipients compute and pay the tax themselves.
figures.applies: The Unified Law on Taxes as the Tax Administration posts it (text of 5 December 2022); later amendments not checked.

sources.said: Salgyt ýumuşçysy diýlip şu Bitewi kanunyň 184-nji maddasynyň 1-nji bölüminde görkezilen tölegleri göni töleýän taraplar ykrar edilýär: Türkmenistanyň dahyllylary - edara görnüşli taraplar; … hususy telekeçiler. … Şu madda laýyklykda salgydy hasaplap çykarmak we tölemek salgyt töleýjiniň salgyt ýumuşçysy tarapyndan tölenýän ähli girdejilerinden geçirilýär, muňa hususy telekeçilere tölenýän girdejiler girmeýär. … ç) raýat-hukuk ylalaşyklary boýunça girdeji alýan hususy telekeçiler we şahsy taraplar (şol sanda hünär hyzmatlaryndan), şu girdejiler alnanda salgyt ýumuşçylary tarapyndan salgyt tutulmaly däldir;

figures.finding: A non-resident pays the 10% income tax on Turkmen-source income, which expressly includes what a theatre, film, radio or television artist or musician earns from his personal activity in Turkmenistan, even when it is paid to someone else, and royalties for the use of copyright; a foreigner leaving within the year files a return within a month of leaving.

value.base: Turkmen-source income, including a performer's personal activity in Turkmenistan and copyright royalties

figures.applies: The Unified Law on Taxes as the Tax Administration posts it (text of 5 December 2022); later amendments not checked.

sources.said: teatr, kino, radio, telewideniýe artisti ýa-da sazanda ýaly sungat işgäri tarapyndan, şeýle hem türgen tarapyndan onuň Türkmenistanyň çäklerindäki şahsy işinden gazanylan girdejiler, hatda bu girdejiler başga birine hasaplanyp ýazylan hem bolsa; … Türkmenistanyň Raýat kodeksinde kesgitlenen, awtorlyk hukugyny peýdalanmakdan we hukugy peýdalanmaga bermekden … Salgyt ýylynyň dowamynda daşary ýurtly şahsy tarap, şu Bitewi kanunyň 196-njy maddasyna laýyklykda ondan alynýan girdejilere salgyt salynmaga degişli işini togtadan we Türkmenistanyň çäklerinden daşary çykyp giden mahalynda, Türkmenistanyň çäginde bolan wagtynda häzirki hasabat (salgyt) döwründe hakykatdan hem alan girdejileri baradaky salgyt beýannamasy Türkmenistanyň çäginden daşary çykyp gitmeginden bir aýdan gijä galman berilmelidir.

figures.finding: An author or performer deducts his documented expenses or, without documents, a share of the fee: 20% for literary works (including for theatre, film, variety and circus) and for performing literary and artistic works, 30% for audiovisual works (video, television and film) and for graphic and design works, 40% for sculpture and for theatre and film art, 25% to 40% for music.
figures.applies: The Unified Law on Taxes as the Tax Administration posts it (text of 5 December 2022); later amendments not checked.

figures.finding: VAT is 15% (0% for listed operations); private entrepreneurs are VAT payers when they make taxable supplies, except for activities under the simplified regime, and privately owned legal entities are not VAT payers; the law sets no turnover threshold.

value.payers: legal entities and private entrepreneurs making taxable supplies
notPayers: private entrepreneurs for activities under the simplified regime

figures.applies: The Unified Law on Taxes as the Tax Administration posts it (text of 5 December 2022); later amendments not checked.
